scope: Operation callback envelopes only. This does not implement or enable Face Unlock.

verification.tdd_red: API scaffold compiled but failed all 16 behavior cases because valid requests were refused.
verification.tdd_green: Focused Python wrapper passed the 16-case Java harness.

full_host_suite.command: MYSTIC_SOURCE_ROOT=<pinned-readers> COLOROS_NATIVE_TOOL_DIR=/usr/bin python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests

independent_review.verdict: ready as an isolated host-only gate

deferred_minor: Document that now must be trusted elapsed realtime sampled when the owner handler evaluates admission, using the same clock and units as begin/expire. Do not use an engine-supplied or earlier callback-arrival timestamp.

review_boundaries.decision: Remain requirements of the future engine/adapter; this gate validates only the matching local token and caller UID.
review_boundaries.cost_if_wrong: An integration that falsely acknowledges closure could reuse the camera too early.

review_boundaries.topic: Payload, engine identity, biometric policy and authentication
review_boundaries.decision: Remain requirements of the Android provider/client integration, not this envelope filter. No provider is registered.
review_boundaries.cost_if_wrong: Using admission as authentication or skipping those checks would be unsafe.

review_boundaries.topic: Working Face Unlock on the device
review_boundaries.decision: Not claimed. Native engine, enrollment, UI and actual device checks remain pending.
review_boundaries.cost_if_wrong: Host-only tests cannot establish a working or secure biometric implementation.

process_ruling: Run the independent review after task tests and before publishing the source, as a separate final-review phase. This changes process order only and waives no review.
